title: Nowhere else. Part 3
note: Silent. Part 3. Opener (0-3.2 s) is the ONLY part that differs by hook: ONE strip, two big faces at the counter, both phones lit mid-swipe (generic glow), one big bright napkin 'why are you / here tonight?' on the counter between them (hook a: slides in from her side from 0.15 s, her hand pushes it, his nervous look; hook b: it waits at her side, she catches his swiping at 0.4, '!' at 0.6, his flinch, then she slides it to him 1.55-2.3). Whole-frame napkin insert 3.2-5.2. Take 1 (A, 5.2-11.0): pie critic act, bottle-cap monocle, waitress slides a REVIEW card 'PIE: 5 STARS. CRITIC: 1 STAR.', he sinks behind the mug. Slice wipe counter-clockwise 11.0 'rewind. take 2.'. Take 2 (B, 12.6-24.45): phone face-down + upside-down mug (close-up, glow goes out), NOWHERE ELSE / TO BE., quiet beat (music to fridge hum), her phone under her mug, me too. I skipped / the drive., they always ask / about the apps., SO, STILL / SINGLE?, every. year., coffee clink payoff (contact 23.25, hold 1.2 s, warm light). Cliff: jukebox lights up, she tilts her head at it with a coin; vote cards 24.6/24.75. End card 30.0. Never the word tip. No NoSwipe mention. Napkins whole-frame ~840 px at y=760.

strips.text: the diner stranger swipes too. she asks why I'm alone on Thanksgiving eve.
she caught me swiping. now she asks why I'm alone tonight.
should I joke, or tell the truth?
take 1: I act like a pie critic.
a bottle cap makes a fine monocle.
then she hides her phone too.
she skipped the family drive too.
her family asks the same question mine does.
I laugh. then I write back.
I write the question we both dodge.
she gets it at every holiday.
she hands me a coin for the jukebox. what do I play?

audio.instruments: late-night jukebox doo-wop ballad; ducks to fridge hum + one celesta note for the heart-to-heart (14.1-19.2); returns for the laugh and the coffee clink
